title: Bill Miller IV: “They’re Not Printing More Bitcoin”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bill Miller IV: “They’re Not Printing More Bitcoin” Bill Miller IV, Chairman and CIO of Miller Value Partners, joins Grace Remington and Sean Hagan on BMTV to explain why he is still bullish on Bitcoin with sentiment near FTX-era lows. This post Bill Miller IV: “They’re Not Printing More Bitcoin” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
